title: Dog Emotion Recognition System
description: Engineered an intelligent canine behavioral recognition and care recommendation system, combining fine-tuned YOLO11 computer vision with a high-performance cross-platform Flutter mobile client.

detail.longDescription: In my undergraduate thesis tackling real-time canine emotional state recognition under unpredictable domestic lighting and diverse dog breeds, I chose to fine-tune a lightweight YOLO11 architecture rather than deploying heavier multi-stage CNN backbones — prioritizing edge inference speed over marginal accuracy gains. I curated and annotated a multi-class canine facial dataset, engineered data augmentation pipelines in Python, and integrated real-time bounding-box inference into a cross-platform Flutter client. The result was a functional mobile prototype achieving 86.4% mAP with sub-50ms inference per frame on mobile hardware. If I did it again, I would incorporate temporal video sequence tracking (Transformers/LSTM) instead of single-frame classification to smooth out transient misclassifications.

title: Pawsitive
description: A 100% offline-first Edge AI iOS app developed at Apple Developer Academy. Evolves my thesis model into Core ML, combining real-time emotion & bounding-box detection, Apple Vision breed classification with whitelist taxonomy, local Llama 3.2 1B SLM advice inference, and SwiftData persistence.

detail.role: Edge AI & iOS Engineer (Apple Developer Academy)
detail.longDescription: In a fast-paced Apple Developer Academy challenge with zero guaranteed internet connectivity for outdoor pet owners, I chose to evolve my thesis into a 100% offline-first Edge AI architecture on iOS — selecting local Core ML and an on-device 1B SLM over cloud APIs like Gemini or OpenAI. I converted custom vision weights to Core ML with an AVFoundation camera pipeline, integrated a quantized Meta Llama 3.2 1B Instruct model (GGUF Q4_K_M via llama.cpp inside a native Swift actor), and built an automated SwiftData persistence layer. The result was a fully offline app running real-time emotion/breed detection and generating structured pet care advice in under 2 seconds in complete flight mode with zero recurring API costs. If I did it again, I would implement dynamic KV-cache pruning to further minimize thermal throttling during extended inference sessions.

title: BasketYuk
description: A live digital ecosystem for the Indonesian basketball community. Currently available on the App Store with 100+ downloads, featuring tournament tracking, club management, and ticketing.

detail.longDescription: In building an all-in-one digital ecosystem for the Indonesian basketball community with strict budget constraints and tight tournament schedules, I chose a shared Flutter mobile codebase paired with a centralized Laravel 12 REST API instead of native Swift/Kotlin — trading platform-specific UI nuances for rapid cross-platform parity and unified backend logic. I architected the relational MySQL schema, implemented real-time tournament bracket generators, built Tripay payment gateway webhooks, and handled AWS S3 media uploads. The result was a live product launched on the Apple App Store with 100+ active downloads, zero transaction loss across production events, and active tournament onboarding. As the platform continues to scale in production, my current engineering focus is implementing bidirectional WebSocket pub/sub (Pusher/Soketi) for instant court scoreboards to eliminate polling overhead during peak tournament traffic.

title: Dogtective Riddle
description: An interactive 2D detective narrative puzzle game published on the App Store, engineered at Apple Developer Academy with Swift and SpriteKit. Designed as a 15-minute eudaimonic casual experience where players solve the mystery of stolen bones across the canine city.

detail.longDescription: In an Apple Developer Academy game sprint aimed at alleviating daily burnout through a 15-minute narrative puzzle experience, I chose 2D SpriteKit with native state machines over heavy third-party engines like Unity — prioritizing instant startup times, zero battery drain, and native Apple HIG compliance. I engineered the police headquarters scene state machine, implemented dynamic urban district map progression, built dialogue clue-deduction puzzles, and managed inventory persistence with Lottie cutscene integration. The result was a shipped and approved title on the Apple App Store, maintaining steady 60 FPS across all supported iPhone devices with zero crash reports. If I did it again, I would build an external level-editor JSON parser earlier in development instead of hardcoding scene coordinates, which would have accelerated puzzle testing.

title: Should I Really?
description: An interactive social media simulation game developed at Apple Developer Academy using Swift. Built to address high school digital literacy pain points discovered through educator interviews, simulating high school life from 10th grade to graduation with Framing & Caption metrics and branching outcomes.

detail.role: iOS & Core Logic Developer (Apple Developer Academy)
detail.longDescription: In an Apple Developer Academy project tackling high school digital literacy dilemmas where educator interviews revealed severe student attention constraints, I chose a 6-round branching scenario simulation in pure Swift rather than a gamified quiz or passive video — trading content volume for emotional consequence and replayability. I built the interactive social feed UI, engineered the underlying dual-metric evaluation engine scoring visual Framing and textual Caption choices, implemented XCTest suites, and integrated native Apple Accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type). The result was a validated educational sim tested with high school educators with 100% test coverage on core scoring algorithms and seamless VoiceOver compatibility. If I did it again, I would introduce randomized scenario permutations between playthroughs to increase long-term replay value beyond the 6 primary narrative arcs.

title: Ubinkayu ERP
description: Architected an enterprise production management & PO tracking system (Desktop Electron & Web) deployed across PT Ubinkayu's manufacturing pipeline, processing 200+ Purchase Orders from factory floor to executive leadership.

detail.longDescription: At manufacturing firm PT Ubinkayu where factory-floor operators and executives relied on fragmented, slow paper logs across physical production sites, I chose an Electron and React desktop-web hybrid instead of an off-the-shelf SaaS ERP — prioritizing bespoke shop-floor workflows and offline resilience over generic subscription software. I architected role-tailored interfaces from factory workers (photo progress verification) to C-suite leadership (financial health & stock levels), synced real-time data via Google Sheets APIs, and embedded an AI business query assistant. The result was full digitalization of the factory operations, successfully processing 200+ Purchase Orders end-to-end and eliminating multi-day production reconciliation bottlenecks. If I did it again, I would adopt SQLite with local-first CRDT syncing instead of direct Google API sync to guarantee zero data loss during unstable factory-floor Wi-Fi outages.

title: GreenThumb
description: Engineered a native multi-platform botanical cataloging and identification application for iOS and macOS using Swift and SwiftUI, featuring modular view architectures and responsive local persistence.

detail.longDescription: In creating an accessible botanical cataloging tool for plant enthusiasts managing multi-device collections across macOS and iOS, I chose a unified Swift and SwiftUI architecture with reactive state management over a cross-platform web view — trading platform portability for buttery-smooth native desktop/mobile integration. I built adaptive master-detail navigation split-views across iPhone and Mac displays, implemented responsive local collection persistence, and structured modular botanical category schemas. The result was a clean, responsive native Apple app with sub-second collection searching and seamless layout adaptation between handheld and desktop form factors. If I did it again, I would integrate Apple's Vision framework for automated leaf disease identification rather than relying solely on manual taxonomy inputs.

title: ScribeSoul
description: A native Android mental health and emotional stabilization application engineered with Kotlin and Firebase, featuring interactive art therapy drawing, mood stabilization tracking, and therapist consultation discovery.

detail.longDescription: In a 3-person agile contract squad developing a mental health stabilization app for users undergoing acute emotional distress, I chose native Kotlin with low-level Android Canvas APIs rather than high-level third-party drawing libraries — prioritizing instant touch response and custom brush smoothing for therapeutic calming effects. I engineered the interactive art therapy canvas, built the home feed and mood tracking workflows using MVVM architecture, and implemented the full Firebase backend (Firestore real-time sync, Auth, and Storage). The result was a stable Android MVP with sub-16ms touch latency on low-end test devices, enabling smooth emotional release drawing and verified therapist appointment inquiries. If I did it again, I would implement local encrypted Room caching for drawings before cloud upload to guarantee zero artwork loss during intermittent connectivity.

title: STRYD
description: A comprehensive social running and sports analytics application built with Kotlin and Laravel, featuring real-time GPS route tracking with Google Maps, group running sessions, gear mileage monitoring, social feeds, and mathematical performance prediction models.

detail.longDescription: In developing a contract social running application where runners frequently train in areas with fluctuating GPS accuracy and varying cellular coverage, I chose native Kotlin paired with Google Maps SDK and a dedicated Laravel API backend rather than an all-in-one Firebase prototype — prioritizing precision telemetry handling and complex relational running club logic. I integrated real-time GPS path tracking and elevation profiling, implemented gear mileage degradation counters to alert footwear wear-out, and built collaborative group running session pipelines. The result was an end-to-end fitness telemetry platform capable of live route plotting with minimal battery drain and verified pace split calculations. If I did it again, I would implement Kalman filtering algorithms on device to smooth out GPS jitter and multipath errors when runners traverse tall urban canyons.

title: BikeFlow
description: Developed a predictive urban mobility analytics platform leveraging time-series machine learning (SARIMAX) to forecast municipal bike-sharing demand against seasonal and meteorological variables.

detail.longDescription: In an urban mobility research initiative addressing municipal bike-sharing imbalances during seasonal and extreme weather shifts, I chose an econometric SARIMAX statistical time-series model in Python over a black-box deep neural net — trading speculative hyperparameter tuning for transparent, interpretable meteorological coefficient weights. I engineered environmental variance features (temperature, precipitation, humidity), tuned seasonal autoregressive parameters, and connected the analytical model to a lightweight interactive web scenario dashboard. The result was a forecast pipeline predicting municipal bike station demand with an RMSE reduction of 18% compared to baseline moving-average models. If I did it again, I would integrate real-time public transit delay feeds into the exogenous feature matrix to capture immediate transit breakdown spillover demand.

title: YuccaGPT
description: Architected an interactive voice-enabled information portal integrating Python, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech (TTS), and a modern React frontend for real-time conversational responses.

detail.longDescription: In a campus project aiming to assist prospective students with rapid audio-visual admissions inquiries without staff intervention, I chose Google Cloud Text-to-Speech (TTS) microservices paired with a lightweight React client rather than hosting a heavy self-hosted speech synthesis model — trading local control for near-instant response latency and human-like natural pronunciation. I built asynchronous Python audio synthesis pipelines, structured question-answering routing logic, and engineered a responsive, accessible React interface with fluid audio playback controls. The result was an operational voice inquiry portal capable of synthesizing contextual admissions responses in under 1.2 seconds across web browsers. If I did it again, I would implement client-side audio streaming via WebSockets rather than awaiting full MP3 buffer generation to reduce time-to-first-sound.

title: Allegro Music Education Centre
description: Architected a comprehensive digital presence and company profile for Allegro Music Education Centre, celebrating 20 years of musical pedagogy with full curriculum catalogs, educator credentials, student achievements, and interactive enrollment pathways.

detail.longDescription: For a renowned music academy with nearly two decades of pedagogical heritage needing a digital transformation to modernize enrollment, I chose lightweight semantic vanilla web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript) deployed on Vercel over heavy CMS frameworks like WordPress — trading dynamic plugin bloat for lightning-fast load times and zero hosting maintenance costs. I structured modular course catalogs (piano, violin, vocal, ensemble), engineered the 20-year institutional history narrative, built an achievement gallery for student competition awards, and crafted mobile-first lead inquiry pathways. The result was a modern production company profile with a 98+ Google Lighthouse performance score and instant load speeds, effectively digitalizing Allegro's regional brand presence. If I did it again, I would integrate an embedded trial-lesson booking scheduler with Google Calendar sync to eliminate back-and-forth manual WhatsApp scheduling.

title: Mandiri Langgeng Perkasa (MLP)
description: Architected a full-stack B2B digital catalog and customer inquiry platform for a leading ceramic supplier in East Kalimantan, transitioning physical inventory to an interactive web portal.

detail.longDescription: For East Kalimantan ceramic distributor Mandiri Langgeng Perkasa whose sales reps relied on bulky physical product binders to conduct wholesale B2B client meetings, I chose a custom PHP and relational MySQL web portal over generic Shopify templates — prioritizing granular wholesale pricing tiers and multi-category ceramic spec filters. I designed normalized relational database schemas in MySQL, built administrative CRUD inventory management interfaces, and developed responsive product discovery views for retail and wholesale buyers. The result was replacing physical binders with an interactive digital catalog holding hundreds of ceramic SKUs, accelerating client inquiry cycles and product lookup times. If I did it again, I would implement client-side indexed search (e.g., Fuse.js or Algolia) to enable instant multi-attribute ceramic filtering without page reloads.

title: EduLiving
description: Built an interactive gamified educational platform for zoological park visitors, featuring dynamic trivia challenges, digital collectible rewards, and real-time score tracking.

detail.longDescription: In a 48-hour rapid prototyping hackathon challenged to boost engagement among younger zoological park visitors, I chose a lightweight gamified web trivia app with digital collectible badges rather than requiring a native app store download — trading native sensors for zero-friction browser onboarding via QR codes. I engineered responsive quiz progression interfaces, built dynamic local state handlers for collectible animal badges, and connected backend score persistence using PHP and MySQL. The result was a fully functional live game demo delivered within the 48-hour deadline, successfully tested by hackathon attendees with an average session completion rate of over 80%. If I did it again, I would implement Service Worker-based PWA caching so kids could continue playing games in areas of the zoo with complete cellular dead zones.

title: DigPro
description: Developed an MVP digital marketplace connecting local SMEs with verified content creators, featuring automated onboarding workflows, subscription pipelines, and lead tracking.

detail.longDescription: In developing an MVP marketplace platform designed to bridge commercial matchmaking between local SMEs and verified regional digital content creators, I chose a streamlined monolithic PHP/MySQL architecture over a distributed microservice setup — trading hypothetical long-term scalability for rapid prototype iteration and immediate deployment. I designed relational database schemas for creator service listings, engineered onboarding and subscription tracking workflows, and built role-based administrative dashboards. The result was an operational MVP marketplace that enabled pilot SMEs to browse creator packages, submit project inquiries, and track deal stages. If I did it again, I would integrate automated escrow payment webhooks into the initial release rather than handling post-inquiry payment verification manually.

title: De Sauge
description: Engineered a bespoke e-commerce storefront for an artisanal food brand, implementing responsive product showcases, interactive cart management, and seamless customer order workflows.

detail.longDescription: For artisanal food brand De Sauge requiring a bespoke online storefront to showcase curated culinary products without high ongoing platform fees, I chose a custom vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 storefront architecture rather than paying recurring Shopify fees — trading pre-built apps for total design freedom and zero monthly overhead. I engineered mobile-first product detail showcases, developed responsive client-side cart management logic, and streamlined direct-to-order WhatsApp checkout pathways. The result was an elegant e-commerce storefront with zero third-party dependencies, sub-second page loads, and seamless mobile purchasing flows. If I did it again, I would integrate headless CMS content schemas (e.g., Sanity) so the brand owner could update seasonal product pricing without code edits.
